'''Squatter's Hill''' was a hill on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chelloa]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It was situated above large deposits of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]], an element used in the manufacture of munitions. Squatter's Hill was located near the settlement of [[Jenith]]. During the [[Raid on Chelloa]], the hill was destroyed by one of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s [[kinetic corruptor]]s which ignited the baradium shale beneath it, creating a firestorm which damaged the nearby [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].
